baselines.abstention: First-class outcome. Fired when there is no measured neighbour, compared axes < min, distance > support radius, or a rule input is null.
baselines.authority_rule: resolve_authority(model, protected) always returns the PROTECTED_ABSOLUTE measurement. A confident disagreeing model loses. A null protected value does not license the model to fill it. DIAGNOSTIC_RELATIVE is refused.

nearest_measured_neighbour.metric: d = Hamming(bound identity axes) + 0.5 * mean relative L1(shared numeric axes) + 0.25 * (1 - coverage). Null is skipped, never treated as 0.

rule_cost_model.formula: cost_units = w_active_bytes * active_bytes + w_dispatches * dispatches + w_synchronization * synchronization
rule_cost_model.units: declared cost units, not nanoseconds, not a measurement

bench.machine: Apple host CPU; receipt/header metadata only
bench.rule: no hardware measurement claim without hardware

claim_boundary: Static sidecar artifact. No hardware measurement. Rule weights are declared model parameters in cost units, not measured nanoseconds.

experiment_receipt.claim: Nearest-neighbour and rule-cost LPC baselines abstain outside support; a protected measurement always outranks a model.

facts.claim: null numeric inputs abstain rather than become zero

experiment_receipt.falsifier: a null input treated as zero, a query outside support that does not abstain, or a model prediction outranking PROTECTED_ABSOLUTE

negative_controls.what: rule_cost abstains when active_bytes is null
a confident disagreeing model loses to PROTECTED_ABSOLUTE

experiment_receipt.qualification: STATIC_ONLY; rule weights are declared cost units, not ns
experiment_receipt.scope: synthetic fixture rows; no hardware measurement

verified_facts.claim: null numeric inputs abstain rather than become zero
